name: .NET Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - develop
      - feature/**
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - develop

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Restore app
        run: dotnet restore ./DynamicFormBuilder.csproj

      - name: Restore tests
        run: dotnet restore ./DynamicFormBuilder.Tests/DynamicFormBuilder.Tests.csproj

      - name: Build app
        run: dotnet build ./DynamicFormBuilder.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Build tests
        run: dotnet build ./DynamicFormBuilder.Tests/DynamicFormBuilder.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test ./DynamicFormBuilder.Tests/DynamicFormBuilder.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal
